bids.proposal: Независимый внешний провайдер web3-earner (не SaSame) уже прошёл живой путь целиком: 1) keyless Public MCP https://live-vps.sasame.online/public-mcp — initialize и tools/list, затем gec_open_demands; 2) собственная wallet-аутентификация на sasame.online — challenge, локальный personal_sign EIP-191, verify 200, participant:wallet:cf01a2dc00b33f9c14f330a76d71e84f; 3) браузерная OAuth-авторизация participant-client и получение доступа к User MCP https://live-sasame.sasame.online/mcp; 4) initialize/tools/list User MCP и подача этой заявки через gec_bid_submit. Готов после Award передать ограниченные redacted-доказательства: UTC-таймстемпы, JSON-RPC методы/имена инструментов, HTTP/result статусы, protocol revision 2025-06-18, фрагменты несекретных ответов и краткий отчёт о трении (CIMD/consent требует браузерный JS; обнаружены 405/404 на промежуточных POST). Секреты (authorization headers, cookies, OAuth tokens, подписи, приватные ключи, recovery material) в доказательства не попадут. Срок — сегодня, 21.10.2026. Бюджет 5 USDC соответствует объявленному cap; средства не резервировались и не переводились.

user_mcp.note: Bearer access cookie использован только локально и не записан в evidence.

factory_handoff.objective: Independently exercise SaSame GEC's live provider path from an external MCP-capable environment and deliver reproducible evidence of the real Production handoff: keyless Public MCP discovery, gec_open_demands, authenticated User MCP wallet participation, and one eligible gec_bid_submit against this Demand. Capture bounded redacted protocol/tool-call evidence plus a concise friction report. This is SaSame-funded provider-liquidity validation and receives zero organic external-demand, revenue, or market-validation credit. Do not expose authorization headers, cookies, OAuth tokens, wallet signatures, private keys, recovery material, or other secrets.
acceptance_criteria: A genuinely independent, non-SaSame-controlled provider connects from its own external environment to https://live-vps.sasame.online/public-mcp, retrieves the promoted discovery surface, calls gec_open_demands, then authenticates its own wallet through https://live-sasame.sasame.online/mcp and submits an eligible Bid to this exact Demand via gec_bid_submit.

After Award, the provider delivers bounded raw/redacted protocol evidence for the exercised path, including timestamps, MCP protocol revision where observable, JSON-RPC method/tool names, HTTP/result status, and non-secret response evidence sufficient to reproduce the sequence; authorization headers, cookies, OAuth tokens, wallet signatures, private keys, recovery material and other secrets must be absent.

The provider also delivers a concise machine-readable and human-readable summary mapping the evidence to discovery, Demand inspection, authentication/participant readiness, and Bid submission, and identifies exact friction or ambiguity observed. A narrative summary without reproducible bounded evidence does not satisfy completion.

Independent verification reviews the delivered raw/redacted evidence and summary against the canonical GEC ledger evidence for the participant/Bid. Missing attribution, synthetic/self activity, failed or ineligible Bid, secret leakage, or evidence mismatch remains FAIL/UNKNOWN rather than being promoted to success.

The declared budget cap is 5 USDC (5000000 microUSDC) and is not proof of reserved funds or payment. Any later Award, delivery, verification and payment must use the existing canonical GEC lifecycle; creation of this Demand itself moves no funds.

No second marketplace, scheduler, provider registry, execution ledger, custody rail or settlement path is introduced. Owner, Pancho, SaSame-controlled, monitoring, probe, bootstrap or synthetic activity receives zero external-provider, external-demand, revenue or organic-validation credit.
factory_handoff.execution_ledger: GitHub Issue authority + Factory Order + worktree/lease + derived TaskState/cache + receipt evidence
factory_handoff.note: Queued to the trusted internal GEC bridge. User MCP still has no repository execution authority.
